findings.title: WebDAV credentials stored in plain text configuration
findings.description: WebDAV password is stored as a plain text string field in the BackupConfig dataclass. While the default is empty, when configured, credentials are stored without encryption in the configuration object.
findings.recommendation: Use environment variables or a secure secrets manager for credential storage. Consider using keyring library for local credential storage.

findings.title: Subprocess execution with external command
findings.description: Uses subprocess.run to execute ripgrep (rg) command. While the command itself is hardcoded, search patterns could potentially be crafted maliciously if not properly sanitized upstream.
findings.recommendation: Ensure all user-provided search patterns are sanitized before passing to ripgrep. Current implementation appears safe as patterns go through the search API.

findings.title: Git command execution via subprocess
findings.description: Uses subprocess.run to execute git commands for checkpoint management. The commit message includes user-provided description which could be exploited if not sanitized.
findings.recommendation: Sanitize the description parameter to prevent shell injection via git commit message. Current risk is low as git handles message as a single argument.

findings.title: JSON deserialization from WebSocket messages
findings.description: WebSocket messages are deserialized using json.loads without schema validation. Malformed or malicious JSON payloads could cause unexpected behavior.
findings.recommendation: Implement JSON schema validation for incoming WebSocket messages. Use pydantic or similar for strict input validation.

findings.title: LLM response deserialization without validation
findings.description: Multiple narrative analysis modules parse LLM responses as JSON without validation. While LLM outputs are generally trusted, malformed responses could cause crashes.
findings.recommendation: Wrap json.loads in try-except blocks with proper error handling. Consider using pydantic models for response validation.

findings.title: HTTP requests with credentials over network
findings.description: WebDAV backup uploads credentials via HTTP requests. While requests library defaults to SSL verification, the credential transmission security depends on proper HTTPS configuration.
findings.recommendation: Enforce HTTPS-only connections for WebDAV. Add explicit verify=True and consider certificate pinning for sensitive backup operations.

findings.title: API response parsing without error boundaries
findings.description: LLM service parses JSON responses without comprehensive error handling, which could expose internal details on failure.
findings.recommendation: Add try-except with generic error messages to prevent information leakage on parse failures.

positive_observations: SQL operations use parameterized queries (db/pool.py) - no SQL injection risk
No eval() or exec() with user input detected
No pickle.load() or yaml.load() with untrusted data found
No SSL verification disabled (verify=False not found)
Subprocess calls use list format, preventing shell injection
File operations use pathlib with proper path handling
